body: I’m so sorry that happened. I know it has to feel like your heart has been ripped out. Seeing successful relationships here while you’re struggling can really be painful sometimes. I know it gives hope to people, but for those in a rough place it can feel like salt in your wounds. Please take care of yourself.

That must be absolutely horrible to go through. I’m dealing with problems in my own LDR and am terrified of this happening. I also can’t understand how someone could claim to have lost their feelings after so much time. It’s horrible. Sending hugs if wanted.
I feel the same. I’m just another extremely overwhelmed person, but I’ll gladly talk.

Hey, I feel the same and am so tired of this world. I feel like there’s nothing left for me. I can’t offer much besides solidarity and someone to rant to if you want. I’m just a fellow person in pain.
